snippet.title: Unboxing Mr. Coo Developer Overview - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Solo developer Nacho Rodriguez popped up during the Spring Showcase to provide viewers with an overview of Unboxing Mr Coo, his hand-drawn, frame-by-frame graphic adventure game. It's a surreal, wordless adventure coming soon to PC.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3873720/Unboxing_Mr_Coo/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
